page.title: Gabriel Olivieri - Full Stack Developer
page.description: Portfolio of Gabriel Olivieri, Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of experience in web platforms, identity and access, cloud and DevOps. Experience, verifiable certifications and delivered projects.

hero.summary: I build and maintain business platforms: identity and access, integrations and reliable cloud deployments. My focus is on what already runs in production, with real users on the other side.

services.intro: I don't do everything. These are the four areas where I have delivered work, certifications that back it up, and my own judgement to make decisions.

product.title: Web platforms and products
points: End-to-end full stack applications: data model, API, interface and production rollout.
Refactoring and maintenance of systems already in use, without interrupting service.

identity.title: Identity, access and security
points: Single Sign-On and federation with Keycloak, OpenID Connect and SAML 2.0.
DevSecOps practices built into the development cycle, not bolted on at the end.

cloud.title: Cloud and DevOps
points: Architectures on AWS and Google Cloud, with infrastructure as code.
Containers, orchestration and continuous delivery pipelines with GitLab CI and Jenkins.

ai.title: Applied generative AI
points: Integrating language models into existing products, with cost and latency in mind.
Automating internal workflows where the model adds measurable value.
